turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: Excuse me, does this bus go to campus?

turns.speaker: navi
turns.text: Ee, wannan bas yana tafiya kai tsaye zuwa jami'a. Yana tsayawa right by the main entrance.

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: How much is a single ticket?

turns.speaker: navi
turns.text: Tikitin guda ɗaya dala biyu ne. Idan kana buƙatar transfer, tambayi direban, kyauta ne.
